LanguageData.MM_RecallDesc: Warp beside the assigned mechanitor. Costs 30% of maximum personal light capacity on the same map, or 50% across maps or from a caravan. Stalkers and Guardians spend the same fraction of construct energy. Requires enough energy and a safe landing cell.
LanguageData.MM_RecallNoOwner: Requires an assigned friendly mechanitor spawned on a map.
LanguageData.MM_RecallUnavailable: Cannot warp while transported, contained or locked by an active ability.
LanguageData.MM_RecallEnergy: Not enough light or construct energy.
LanguageData.MM_RecallNoCell: No safe space near the mechanitor fits this mech.
